## Problem

State what does not work or what must change.
Give one clear result for this issue.

## Source

Give the source revision and file link.
If a fault came from a test, give the test command and the result.

## Steps

1. State the starting conditions.
2. State the action.
3. State the expected result.
4. State the actual result.

## Tests required

- [ ] Add a repeatable test for the fault, when possible.
- [ ] Run the applicable CI checks.
- [ ] Run a browser or native test when the result needs it.
- [ ] Record tests that did not run.

## Done when

State the conditions that must pass before this issue can close.

## Controlled-English review

Use the terms in [the glossary](../../docs/glossary.md).
Use short sentences and direct instructions.
Mark this text as **STE-aligned draft** unless a full ASD-STE100 review is recorded.
See [MADR 0003](../../docs/adr/0003-use-asd-ste100-for-communication.md).
